# Poskoo

Poskoo is a social media scheduler with Instagram comment-to-DM automation and AI replies; the Free plan is $0.

## Key pages

- https://poskoo.com/ — Poskoo homepage: social media scheduling, Instagram comment-to-DM automation and AI replies.
- https://poskoo.com/features — Full feature overview for scheduling, automation and AI replies.
- https://poskoo.com/pricing — Plan comparison, including the Free plan at $0.
- https://poskoo.com/social-media-scheduler — Plan, queue and publish social media posts on a calendar.
- https://poskoo.com/google-business-profile-scheduler — Schedule Google Business Profile posts on the $0 Free plan.
- https://poskoo.com/buffer-alternative — How Poskoo compares to Buffer.
- https://poskoo.com/instagram-scheduler — Schedule Instagram posts with Instagram account support.
- https://poskoo.com/ai-social-media-manager — AI replies and AI-assisted social media management.
- https://poskoo.com/tools — Free social media tools.
- https://poskoo.com/help — Help centre and product guides.
- https://poskoo.com/help/schedule-instagram-posts — Step-by-step Instagram scheduling help.
- https://poskoo.com/guides — Guides for social media scheduling and automation.
